neet_che_u09_t06_1.working: Fluorine has the highest Pauling electronegativity (3.98), above O (3.44), Cl (3.16) and N (3.04).

neet_che_u09_t06_2.working: BeO, ZnO and SnO are all amphoteric. Na2O is basic, SO3 and SiO2 are acidic, so options 1, 2 and 4 each contain a non-amphoteric oxide.

neet_che_u09_t06_3.working: Li has the highest ionization enthalpy in group 1. Its very small ion has a very large hydration enthalpy, which outweighs this and gives the most negative E°.

neet_che_u09_t06_4.working: Cl2O7 is the anhydride of HClO4, a very strong acid, so its aqueous solution is strongly acidic. R is true and directly explains A.

neet_che_u09_t06_5.working: Statement I is false: Al2O3 is amphoteric and reacts with both HCl and NaOH. Statement II matches NCERT: reactivity is lowest in the centre of a period, and halogens are strong oxidisers.
